formulas.description:
The name of the original opportunity linked on the contract in the Opportunity field (SBQQ__RenewedContract__r.SBQQ__Opportunity__r.Name) will be used as the starting point for the name of the renewal opportunity
All instances of the string “ Renewal Opportunity” and “ - Renewal Opp” will be replaced with an empty string in the renewal opportunity name
The renewal opportunity name will be truncated to 105 characters (i.e., LEFT([Renewal Opportunity Name],105) prior to the next The string “ - Renewal Opp” will be appended to the renewal opportunity name
formulas.name: formula_RenewalOppName
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!$Record.SBQQ__RenewedContract__r.SBQQ__Opportunity__c}),{!$Record.Account.Name} & " - Renewal Opp",LEFT(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.SBQQ__RenewedContract__r.SBQQ__Opportunity__r.Name}," Renewal Opportunity", "")," - Renewal Opp",""), 105) & " - Renewal Opp")

formulas.name: formula_SalesARRAfterSplit
formulas.expression: IF(AND({!$Record.IsClosed}, NOT({!$Record.IsWon}), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Type} , 'Renewal') || {!$Record.Renewed_Contract_Count__c} > 0 || {!$Record.Incoming_ARR_Override__c} <> 0), 0, IF(AND(NOT({!$Record.IsClosed}), TEXT({!$Record.RVP_CHURN_RISK_OVERIDE__c}) = 'Full Churn'), 0, IF(AND(ISBLANK({!$Record.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__c}) , TEXT({!$Record.Type}) != 'Split'), {!formula_SalesARRBeforeSplit} * ({!$Record.Split_Percent__c}/100), IF(AND(OR({!$Record.Split_Percent__c} = 100, ISBLANK({!$Record.Split_Percent__c})) , TEXT({!$Record.Type}) != 'Split'), {!$Record.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.Day_1_ARR__c}, IF(AND({!$Record.Split_Percent__c} != 100, TEXT({!$Record.Type}) != 'Split'), {!$Record.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.Day_1_ARR__c} * ({!$Record.Split_Percent__c}/100), IF(AND({!$Record.Split_Percent__c} = 0, TEXT({!$Record.Type}) = 'Split'), {!$Record.Ramped_Opportunity__r.Sales_ARR_before_Split__c},{!$Record.Ramped_Opportunity__r.Sales_ARR_before_Split__c} * ({!$Record.Split_Percent__c}/100)))))))

formulas.name: formula_SalesARRBeforeSplit
formulas.expression: IF(AND({!$Record.IsClosed}, NOT({!$Record.IsWon})), 0, IF(AND(NOT({!$Record.IsClosed}), TEXT({!$Record.RVP_CHURN_RISK_OVERIDE__c}) = 'Full Churn'), 0, IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__c})), {!$Record.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.Day_1_ARR__c}, IF(AND(OR(ISCHANGED({!$Record.Day_1_ARR__c}), ISNEW()), ISBLANK({!$Record.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__c})), {!$Record.Day_1_ARR__c}, IF(TEXT({!$Record.Type}) = 'Split', {!$Record.Ramped_Opportunity__r.Sales_ARR_before_Split__c}, {!$Record.Sales_ARR_before_Split__c})))))

formulas.name: formula_StageDate_QualificationDate
formulas.expression: IF( OR( AND( ISNEW(), {!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName} = 'Open', {!formula_StageNumber} >= 3, {!formula_StageNumber} <= 9, {!formula_StageNumber} != 7 ), AND( ISCHANGED({!$Record.StageName}), {!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName} = 'Open', {!formula_StageNumber} >= 3, {!formula_StageNumber} <= 9, {!formula_StageNumber} != 7, {!$Record__Prior.StageNumber__c} <= 2 ) ), TODAY(), {!$Record.Stage_Date_Qualification_Date__c} )

formulas.name: formula_StageDate_Stage2
formulas.expression: IF( OR( AND( {!formula_StageNumber} = 2, OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED({!$Record.StageName}) ) ), AND( {!formula_StageNumber} >= 3, {!formula_StageNumber} <= 9, {!formula_StageNumber} != 7, {!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName} = 'Open', ISBLANK({!$Record.Discovery_Date__c}), OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED({!$Record.StageName}) ) ) ), TODAY(), {!$Record.Discovery_Date__c} )

formulas.description: Since StageNumber__c can't be used for evaluation in Before Insert flows, the formula is being recreated here
formulas.name: formula_StageNumber
formulas.expression: CASE(TEXT({!$Record.StageName}), 'Prospecting', 1, 'Discovery', 2, 'Validating Benefits & Value', 3, 'Pilot & Value Validated', 4, 'Tech Win & Negotiations', 5, 'Waiting for Signature', 6, 'Uncommitted Renewal', 7, 'Signed - Paperwork received', 8, 'CLOSED WON', 9, 'Failed', 10, 'POC', 114, 'Failed Renewal', 110, NULL )

formulas.name: formula_SVPEdgeDeal
formulas.expression:
IF(TEXT({!$Record.SVP_Edge_Deal_Override__c}) = 'TRUE', TRUE, IF(TEXT({!$Record.SVP_Edge_Deal_Override__c}) = 'FALSE', FALSE, IF(AND(OR(TEXT({!$Record.Forecast__c}) = 'Commit', {!$Record.RVP_Commit__c}, {!$Record.AVP_Commit__c}), {!$Record.In_Forecast__c} = FALSE ,{!formula_StageNumber} >= 5, {!formula_StageNumber} <= 8), TRUE, FALSE)))
/*logic before SS-8866 IF({!$Record.In_Forecast__c}, FALSE, IF(TEXT({!$Record.SVP_Edge_Deal_Override__c}) = 'TRUE', TRUE, IF(TEXT({!$Record.SVP_Edge_Deal_Override__c}) = 'FALSE', FALSE, IF(AND(TEXT({!$Record.Forecast__c}) = 'Commit', {!$Record.RVP_Commit__c}, {!$Record.AVP_Commit__c}, {!formula_StageNumber} >= 5, {!formula_StageNumber} <= 8), TRUE, FALSE)))) */
